'''2018 EGP Day 2 Reid Smith LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Reid Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan 7.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127135112/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
